label: Reality-grounded possibility versus positive existential powers at the first being
summary: Step 2 continuation of #1887's exact P/¬P at one rigid, actual foundational n (not a new proposition): docs/notes/foundational-absence-warrant.md §11. Reused #1888/#1889/#1896/#1897 and their structural verdicts, omission models and independent semantic reviews for unchanged claims. Differentiated G0 (objective reality constraint on genuine possibility), G1 (positive possibility-maker) and G2 (PGP's material disjunction of in-subject corruptibility and POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 for an actual being's possible absence, with no added actuality requirement on the power holder). Pruss's 2008 account itself distinguishes necessitarian restrictive-essence and possibilitarian power-based actualisms: G0 cannot settle the possibility of n's absence. Read Aquinas De ente c.3 (Corpus Thomisticum; c.4 in some translations), ST I q.9 a.1-2, q.45 a.2 and q.104 a.1,3, Aristotle Met. Theta and Pruss's 2008 note; locators, interpretation and no-source-claim boundary are in note. Positive argument reconstructs explanatory warrant from dependent beings while identifying its open subjectless generalization; rebuttal distinguishes another-world nonexistence from a transition, and identifies unconditional exercise of the act–essence as an additional bridge without treating AN 823d4312/565ccd6c as established. Same-n parity retained; no novel Lean, result, modal framework, source claim, statement or definition added: existing 1e6174ab, 39df9612, 872a3832, conditionalIdentity, BruteFoundationalModel and Pruss separation controls cover the inferences considered here. EC's verdict needs 857654fe, 9d8a8d2e, 38200db5 and d1af2b06. #1914 adds conditional actual grounding without a necessity verdict. Attempt 91e562cc isolates warrant for an exhaustive rigid roster as a separate epistemic question. Review and repairs are recorded in PR-1901. Section 12 tests the unrestricted n of #1968 (70d1370d) against a primitive necessary law. Two executed archive controls publish identical file bytes and keep each publication fixed: the parent rule requires the same named version A in one and an independently built complete archive never contains A in the other. This calibrates a subtraction criterion within a known boundary, with explicit content versus physical copy limits. At n a necessary exercise by this individual requires n; a conditional singular law may admit joint omission as a satisfaction condition without warranting a real history. Complete predictions about creature histories need not identify their concrete prerequisites. Counterfactual authority distinguishes a law from an accidental regularity even without a triggering case. Requiring a local concrete capacity for that authority would exclude concrete emptiness if such authority is necessary, but supplies no rigid holder. If this very giver is indispensable for this derivative, its withholding can explain the derivative's absence throughout. Other possible suppliers reopen that inference. The two-member control 9bba1325 concerns power for an outcome. The separate thin collective control 8ad1804e concerns the transfer to distributive power over esse. Neither identifies its bearer with n. The paired tests support suspension at n and do not supersede d067722e. Prior review in PR-1901 covers the earlier work only. Independent challenge of section 12 at eb710c5253873ed6088f35e29db6154046704e30 identified the indispensable-giver qualification and the distinct power-control citations. Both were repaired in 4b24274dd2c7dd274e282011f4a560a11ddaf10e. The coordinator rechecked those two points against the fixed derivative and Controls.CollectiveWithoutDistributive / Model.TwoMemberCollective.
blocker: The non-question-begging bridge from actualist G0 to G2 is still unsupported at a first, unreceived n. The exact next tests: independently defend the unconditionally exercised act-essence against EC's conditional nature (AN 823d4312); justify positive-maker completeness for subjectless non-occurrence without restating PGP; restore full pure actuality and unrestricted simplicity in the best conditionalIdentity/bruteSimple structural model; distinguish a power to cease giving esse to another from the possibility of oneself never existing. No metaphysical admissibility of a contingent purely actual foundation is certified. For the primitive-law test, resolve whether the necessary law essentially includes an obtaining exercise of n across all admissible orders, or identify independently warranted complete realization conditions incompatible with n (even as an additional bearer). Repeating a projection to creature effects cannot adjudicate this. See §12 for populated and concrete-empty cases, and e5d49f99 / 402e5643 for the conditional same-mover route.
